title.narrative: Project to educate and assist the youth councillors of Colombia - ONJL and DSU

description.narrative: In November 2022, Oscar and Daniel of DSU’s Sydamerikagruppe visited the ONJL and several youth councils in Colombia. This visit was a great success, and already on that trip, a project group was founded, and a partnership agreement between the DSU and ONJL was signed (Annex B). It was also agreed that the DSU and ONJL should work together on creating a project concerning young people's participation in the democratic process in Colombia, more specifically, helping and assisting the youth councilors' work. Even though no specific model has yet been agreed upon, the project has a clear vision; an educational camp with youth councilors from all over Colombia gathering for 1 or 2 weeks to learn about how to become more competent, skillful, passionate, and influential in their work in their local youth councils. As the DSU has a long and proud history of educating young political leaders, the project group agreed that it would be a good idea to conduct the preparatory study in Denmark at the start of April so that the project group could together go to the biggest educational course of the year in the DSU, the Påskekursus. Along with participating in several courses, the project group will also have workshops and meetings to plan the project in Colombia.
